summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, reporting its unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains routine quarterly results, including sales of $342.5M, net income from continuing operations of $119.9M, and basic EPS of $0.36. It also notes restated comparative figures due to discontinued operations. There is no mention of any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. This is a standard periodic report with no special-situation event.
